subject.title: feat(auto-reply): add "commentary" verbose level for narration-only progress

question: Should OpenClaw permanently add `commentary` as a shared session-level `/verbose` preset across channels, gateway clients, TUI, and Control UI?
rationale: This is a coherent implementation, but it creates a new user-facing setting and command contract across several owner surfaces; repository evidence cannot determine that product commitment without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor session-only preset
options.body: Accept the shared preset while retaining the existing persisted config enum, then require a clean rebase and exact-head validation.

options.title: Keep channel-specific controls
options.body: Decline the global session preset and use channel-owned controls such as Slack progress commentary where operators need the split.

options.title: Defer the surface
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open for later design work without merging this broad command and UI surface now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor session-only preset
recommendation.body: Accept the shared preset while retaining the existing persisted config enum, then require a clean rebase and exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Among the history-backed candidates, this person is the strongest available router for a cross-runtime, gateway, UI, and product-surface decision.
